sources.notes: Markhöjdmodell item 663_63, the 10 km square WEST of easting 640000, and the western 880 m of the reviewed v2 window. It keeps the bare id because tools that write into this manifest -- build-ground-rings and publish-ground-rings -- name a ground's terrain source that way; its eastern neighbour is terrain-lm-1m-east and the two together are what backs this ground. Read at factor 1 only, so every published sample is a source pixel copied exactly. The 0.3 m horizontal and 0.1 m vertical figures are source-advertised uncertainty, not independent residuals for either course.

Markhöjdmodell item 663_64, the 10 km square east of easting 640000, captured one day before its western neighbour. Håmö straddles the boundary: this item supplies the eastern 1,168 m of the reviewed window, all of Mellanbanan and the east end of Stora banan. Same product, lattice and datum as the west item, so the seam is one of provenance and not of geometry.

Nested resolution rings read from the Markhöjdmodell dtm-cog items over authenticated range requests: 1 m over the course (asserted against the published tiles), 2 m subsampled to 1.5 km, and the averaged overviews at 4, 8, 16 and 32 m to a 16 km root. Item identities (ETag, size, date) and the transfer are recorded; no credential material is.

The authenticated 2049 x 2049 finest window on the reviewed EPSG:3006 lattice: source items, ETags, the exact pixel windows read at factor 1, the Float32 raster hash and every sample statistic. The raster itself stays in the ignored acquisition cache.
The wider 1 m and 32 m reads that the pack HF0 and HF1 are cut from. Their footprint is the rotated legacy frame's, so it is a different rectangle from the v2 window and is recorded separately.

The Mellanbanan nine the app actually ships, built by tools/build-nine.mjs on the parent ground. Deliberately NOT id-prefixed legacy-, so migrate-legacy.mjs does not try to migrate it to the same output name as the championship model; its EPSG:3006 form is migration-mellanbanan-course-model-epsg3006 below and should be regenerated through PROJ when that toolchain is available.

The SHIPPED nine in absolute EPSG:3006, and the routing the v2 course manifest claims tiles for. Projected with the repository's own Krüger series because PROJ was unavailable; the driver first reproduced the committed cs2cs migration of this same ground to 1.3 mm over all 12,925 of its coordinates and refuses to write otherwise. The older migration-middle-model-epsg3006 is the banguide TRACE, which disagrees with this routing by up to 164 m on holes 7 and 8.

Pinned Laserdata Skog inventory: one March 2021 leaf-off campaign (21c037) split over items 21c037-663_63 and 21c037-663_64 with the known E 640000 provenance seam the terrain window already crosses; 2.05-2.18 returns/m2. record-laser-campaigns --check re-derives the live catalogue and fails on drift. Leaf-off under-detects deciduous crowns; audit before believing a thinned forest (the Johannesberg lesson).
